freshly_checked_applications.title: Spherical Satake at the exact source normalization
freshly_checked_applications.source: B. H. Gross, On the Satake isomorphism, Proposition3.6, formula(3.14), Proposition6.4; Haar normalization(2.5)
freshly_checked_applications.hypotheses_checked: Actual finite characteristic-zero local field, GL_n, maximal integral compact and volume1, smooth irreducible spherical representation, all fixed vectors and uniformizers; original Hecke polynomial and geometric Frobenius inverse are derived separately.

freshly_checked_applications.title: Generic unitary local representations as products of discrete-series twists
freshly_checked_applications.source: C. Mœglin and J.-L. Waldspurger, Le spectre résiduel de GL(n), §§I.10–I.11, pp.639–640
freshly_checked_applications.hypotheses_checked: Actual nonarchimedean characteristic-zero local field, positive rank, smooth irreducible generic unitarisable complex representation, original normalized upper-parabolic induction. The Whittaker condition eliminates longer local Speh factors and leaves real exponents in the strict interval(-1/2,1/2). No temperedness assumption or global residual-spectrum classification is imported.
